name: shutdown-check
description: Close the workday with a brief check of open commitments and the next step.
---

# Shutdown check

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Review known unfinished commitments and the next day's time-sensitive events. Highlight anything requiring attention before stopping and suggest one small next action or a plan for the next workday. Do not claim the day is complete or mark tasks done. Let the user skip or defer without changing task or event status.
